caption: The drawing depicts a single candle holder made of wrought iron, centered on a plain off-white background. The candle holder features a conical cup at the top for holding a candle, supported by two symmetrical, scroll-like arms that curve outward and downward, then inward to form tight spirals at the base. At the lower center, between the spirals, is a stylized leaf motif attached to one of the curving arms. The entire candle holder is rendered in shades of brown, with a slightly reddish tone, suggesting a rusted or antiqued metal finish. The base is rectangular and flat, supporting the structure. There are no additional objects in the composition. On the lower right corner of the drawing, there is a handwritten signature in brown ink reading "Martin N. Hanson."
title: Candlesticks
